Definition: from the base of G4982 and G3962; of a safe father; Sopatrus, a Christian:--Sopater. Compare G4989.
BiblicalUsage: Sopater of Berea is named among those who accompanied Paul into Asia on his last journey to Jerusalem. His name means of a safe father, and he is listed first among the companions, a Berean who travelled with the apostle.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the travelling companions matter: the gospel moved on the feet of men like Sopater, and I hold that faithfulness on the road counts.
